title: Shop products
summary: 81 products: shards, boosts, rift items, cosmetics, storage, resets, gemstones and bundles.

blocks.text: Shards in six sizes, with up to +60% bonus. Boosts : personal (30 min or 2 h), server and global (30 min). They add up: see Boosts . Rift items : rift summons, anomaly rifts, private rifts and server boost tokens. Cosmetics, bag slots, profile slots, resets, extra lives and gemstones. Bundles and the premium battle pass.
